name: MigMag
description: Created from preset: Blank Canvas (New Pointcrawl)
author: Creator Studio World Architect

npcs.name: Lady Margaret
npcs.motivation: Enforce naval quarantine until Judge Grey hands down the signed Harmondale charter[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: Passage to Harmondale is strictly permanent; once the ship departs Emerald Isle, the island cannot be revisited.

leverage.vulnerability: Adherence to maritime law and Markham's explicit naval seal.
leverage.bribe: Delivery of Judge Grey's signed victory charter.

dialogueHooks: The Lady Margaret stays lashed to this slipway until Lord Markham's hunt is won[cite: 1].

relationships.notes: Answers directly to Markham for departure clearance[cite: 1].
Requires Grey's verification before permitting contestants aboard[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Mia Lucille
npcs.motivation: Track incoming contestant gossip and protect young islanders from reckless ventures[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: Brent Filiant ventured up the bluffs without antivenom and was mauled near the northern ridgeline[cite: 1].

leverage.vulnerability: Fear of dragonfire sweeping the lower village.
leverage.bribe: A friendly ear and news from mainland Erathia.

dialogueHooks: Keep your boots dry and your eyes sharp, travelers[cite: 1]. There are worse things than dragonflies nesting up in the hills.

relationships.notes: Corresponds regularly with Donna on the eastern shore[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Master Kane
npcs.role: Master Blacksmith of The Knight's Blade
npcs.motivation: Equip serious adventurers with forged steel while turning a tidy profit on repair jobs[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: A well-crafted Longbow was carried into the dragon's lair by the last adventuring group[cite: 1].

leverage.vulnerability: Running low on quality iron billets due to naval supply embargoes.
leverage.bribe: Bulk custom repair orders and salvaged weapons.

dialogueHooks: Welcome to The Knight's Blade[cite: 1]! Need edge on that broadsword before you head into the brush?

relationships.notes: Co-manages the settlement's defense supply with Erik[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Erik
npcs.motivation: Ensure no competitor dies simply for lack of thick leather or studded mail[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: Dragonfly stingers punch right through light cloth; boiled leather or ringmail is mandatory in the marsh.

leverage.vulnerability: Pride in his defensive craft; despises seeing contestants butchered.
leverage.bribe: Hard coin for defensive suits and shields[cite: 1].

dialogueHooks: Step inside Erik's Armory[cite: 1]. If you go into the hills without armor, don't expect the healer to put you back together.

relationships.notes: Shares workshop coal and tooling with Kane[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Alyssa the Bard
npcs.motivation: Extract maximum gold from desperate contestants by selling her concert lute[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: Her rosewood lute is the only musical instrument available on the island that satisfies Judge Grey's checklist[cite: 1].

leverage.vulnerability: She has no bodyguards; intimidation or direct legal threats can rattle her.
leverage.bribe: Payment of 500 gold pieces in cash[cite: 1].

dialogueHooks: Need an instrument for the Judge[cite: 1]? Five hundred gold pieces, not a copper less[cite: 1]!

relationships.notes: Capitalizes on Grey's contest item requirements[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Barnaby the Barkeep
npcs.motivation: Keep the tavern profitable and maintain order between rival contestant factions[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: Mr. Malwick carries contraband from the mainland and corners promising groups near the cellar entrance.

leverage.vulnerability: Terrified of brawls smashing his imported glassware.
leverage.bribe: Buying tavern rounds and tipping generously for food rations.

dialogueHooks: Rest your boots at Two Palms[cite: 1]! Ale is fresh, stew is warm, and weapons stay sheathed at my counter.

relationships.notes: Watches Malwick suspiciously as he propositions patrons in the tavern shadows.

npcs.name: Mr. Malwick
npcs.motivation: Lure the winning contestant party into accepting an illicit Wand of Fireballs to establish leverage over Castle Harmondale.

secretsKnown.secret: The wand carries an extortionate blood-debt to Niles Stantley and his mercenary legion on the mainland.

leverage.vulnerability: Exposure to Judge Grey will lead to his arrest and the confiscation of his contraband.
leverage.bribe: A verbal oath to honor a future favor when Harmondale is won.

dialogueHooks: Psst! You want an edge in Lord Markham's hunt? Take this Wand of Fireballs—free of charge, between friends.

relationships.notes: Tolerated by Barnaby only so long as he doesn't start tavern fights.
Evades Grey's jurisdiction while subverting the contest rules[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Carolyn Weathers
npcs.motivation: Screen aspiring sorcerers and grant official charters for Air and Fire magic studies[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: The Pedestal of Haste and Pedestal of Fire Resistance were constructed by the early Fire and Air guildmasters[cite: 1].

leverage.vulnerability: Devotion to formal guild protocol and fear of rogue elemental spellcraft.
leverage.bribe: Standard guild initiation dues (50 gold per disciple).

dialogueHooks: I sponsor applicants for the Initiate Guilds of Air and Fire[cite: 1]. Show me focus, and your parchment will be signed.

relationships.notes: Coordinates island magical guild admissions alongside Tellmar[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Lord Markham
npcs.role: Patron of the Contest & Lord of Tidewater
npcs.motivation: Offload the ruined, borderland keep of Castle Harmondale onto capable heroes while suppressing reports of the dragon[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: He knowingly launched the contest despite knowing Morcarack slumbers in the northeastern cliffs[cite: 1].

leverage.vulnerability: Panic among the contestants if word of Morcarack's slaughter leaks[cite: 1].
leverage.bribe: Recovery of the missing contestants' heraldic crest to quietly settle the incident[cite: 1].

dialogueHooks: Welcome to my proving grounds[cite: 1]! Bring the six tokens to Judge Grey, or bring me proof of my lost scouts[cite: 1]!

relationships.notes: Shares administrative authority over the contest[cite: 1].
Fears the red dragon will breach its cavern and destroy the port[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Judge Thomas Grey
npcs.motivation: Verify all six scavenger relics with uncompromising legal rigor[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: The six tokens were chosen because each proves mastery in trading, exploration, combat, and resourcefulness[cite: 1].

leverage.vulnerability: Strict adherence to legal precedents; he cannot bend the item requirements by a single token.
leverage.bribe: Presentation of the six verified scavenger tokens[cite: 1].

dialogueHooks: Lay the instrument, hat, bow, shell, tile, and red draft before me[cite: 1]. Only then do you board the vessel.

relationships.notes: Administers the contest charter on Markham's behalf[cite: 1].
Directs Margaret to prepare departure only upon verified completion[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Sister Agnes
npcs.role: Chief Cleric of the Healer's Tent
npcs.motivation: Mend injured contestants and purge dragonfly venom before fever claims their lives[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: The temple well restores mana while the village well cures bodily wounds[cite: 1].

leverage.vulnerability: Shortage of clean medicinal linen and fresh holy water.
leverage.bribe: Modest temple donations and respectful conduct.

dialogueHooks: Enter and find succor[cite: 1]. May the light cleanse your venom and bind your wounds.

relationships.notes: Trades healing salves and empty vials with the alchemist[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Master Tellmar
npcs.motivation: Maintain the standards of Body and Spirit magical disciplines across the settlement[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: The Temple of the Moon to the north was dedicated to lunar divination before vermin infested its lower chambers[cite: 1].

leverage.vulnerability: Fears untrained novices will desecrate the spirit shrines.
leverage.bribe: Standard guild fee of 50 gold pieces per student[cite: 1].

dialogueHooks: Welcome to the Tellmar residence[cite: 1]. I grant credentials for the Initiate Guilds of Body and Spirit[cite: 1].

relationships.notes: Co-regulates island guild memberships[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Drillmaster Karr
npcs.role: Master Instructor of Island Training Grounds
npcs.motivation: Drill green contestants into seasoned combatants capable of surviving the frontier[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: Combatants who reach level 5 can handle the temple spiders with disciplined ranged fire[cite: 1].

leverage.vulnerability: Contempt for lazy or cowardly recruits.
leverage.bribe: Payment of standard military training tuition[cite: 1].

dialogueHooks: Feet set, shields high! You're on the Island Training Grounds[cite: 1]—let's see if you can hold a battle line!

relationships.notes: Contracted by Markham to prepare prospective Harmondale lords[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Zander the Alchemist
npcs.motivation: Brew curative draughts and sell reagents to island scavengers[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: A simple Red Potion can be brewed by combining an empty bottle with wild red herbs found along the wetlands[cite: 1].

leverage.vulnerability: Constant shortage of freshly harvested marsh herbs.
leverage.bribe: Supplying rare dried ingredients or paying retail prices for elixirs[cite: 1].

dialogueHooks: Welcome to The Blue Bottle[cite: 1]! Need a Red Potion to mend cracked bones or trade up in the hills[cite: 1]?

relationships.notes: Knows Brent desperately needs a Red Potion to survive[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Lady Vaelia
npcs.motivation: Appraise artifacts, identify mysterious gear, and trade magical items[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: The Pedestal of Haste grants speed, while the northern mountain pedestal bestows the Day of the Gods[cite: 1].

leverage.bribe: Paying identification appraisal fees and purchasing spellbooks[cite: 1].

dialogueHooks: Step into Emerald Enchantments[cite: 1]. Have you relics to identify, or do you seek enchanted protection?

relationships.notes: Supplies arcane reagents to Weathers' guild students[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Donna Wyrith
npcs.motivation: Track dragon movements and warn careless wanderers away from Morcarack's basalt ridge[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: She watched three heavily armed contestants enter the northeast cave two days ago; none ever returned[cite: 1].

leverage.vulnerability: Isolation on the eastern shore leaves her vulnerable to marsh beast incursions.
leverage.bribe: Clearing the dragonflies from her immediate yard.

dialogueHooks: Turn around if you're chasing glory in the northeast[cite: 1]. The smoke curling from those rocks isn't campfires.

relationships.notes: Exchanges warning carrier pigeons with Mia in the village[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Brent Filiant
npcs.motivation: Obtain a curative Red Potion before dragonfly fever and spider toxins claim his life[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: His plumed velvet hat was intended as his scavenger submission, but his life matters far more[cite: 1].

leverage.vulnerability: Advanced fever delirium; incapable of walking down the bluffs unassisted[cite: 1].
leverage.bribe: A single standard Red Potion handed over immediately[cite: 1].

dialogueHooks: The burning in my veins won't stop... bring me a Red Potion from the alchemist, and this Wealthy Hat is yours[cite: 1]!

relationships.notes: Pleads for medicine from Zander's shelves[cite: 1].

npcs.name: Morcarack the Pitiless
npcs.motivation: Incinerate trespassers and slumber atop his hoard within the basalt mountain[cite: 1].

secretsKnown.secret: The fallen adventurers lie just inside the cave entrance; their Longbow and crest can be snatched without entering his breath weapon cone[cite: 1].

leverage.vulnerability: Lethargic slumber; agile trespassers blessed with Haste can slip past his peripheral vision[cite: 1].
leverage.bribe: Scattering heavy gold coin pouches across the floor creates a brief distraction.

dialogueHooks: MORE ASH FOR MY FLOOR! DID THE CREATURE IN THE MANOR SEND YOU TO BURN AS WELL[cite: 1]?

relationships.notes: Views Markham's settlement as insects to be tolerated until provoked[cite: 1].

quests.title: The Scavenger Hunt for Harmondale
quests.notes: Deliver all six mandatory scavenger tokens to Judge Thomas Grey at Markham's Headquarters (Node 10)[cite: 1]: 1) Alyssa's Lute (Node 5, bought for 500 gold)[cite: 1]; 2) Brent's Wealthy Hat (Node 30, traded for a Red Potion)[cite: 1]; 3) A Red Potion (Node 18, bought at The Blue Bottle or brewed)[cite: 1]; 4) A Giant Seashell (Node 24, recovered from the coastal hut)[cite: 1]; 5) A Lunar Floor Tile (Node 29, retrieved from the Temple of the Moon)[cite: 1]; 6) A Longbow (Node 26, salvaged from the Dragon's Lair or shops)[cite: 1]. Completing the hunt grants legal ownership of Castle Harmondale and clearance for Lady Margaret to sail (Node 1)[cite: 1].

quests.title: Find the Missing Contestants
quests.notes: Lord Markham seeks proof regarding the fate of the favorite adventuring team who vanished into the northeastern mountains[cite: 1]. Infiltrate The Dragon's Lair (Node 26), avoid or distract Morcarack, recover the Scorched Contestant's Shield, and present it to Lord Markham at Node 10 for a substantial gold bounty[cite: 1].

quests.name: A Shady Favor from Mr. Malwick
quests.title: A Shady Favor from Mr. Malwick
quests.notes: Mr. Malwick lurks outside Two Palms Tavern (Node 6), offering a smuggled Wand of Fireballs to quickly clear the island's monsters. Accepting the gift creates a binding debt with mainland criminal syndicates once the party becomes Lords of Harmondale.

quests.title: The Four Guild Charters
quests.notes: Secure official membership charters for all four elemental and spiritual disciplines: visit Carolyn Weathers (Node 8) to join the Air and Fire Guilds[cite: 1], and visit the Tellmar Residence (Node 14) to join the Body and Spirit Guilds[cite: 1], granting full access to spellbook vendors at Nodes 16, 17, 19, and 23[cite: 1].

items.name: Alyssa's Rosewood Lute
items.specs: Concert-grade six-course rosewood lute (+1 Performance; market price 500 gold)[cite: 1].
items.notes: The singular instrument available to fulfill Judge Grey's scavenger requirement[cite: 1]. Held by Alyssa until purchased[cite: 1].

items.name: Brent's Plumed Wealthy Hat
items.specs: Embroidered nobleman's cap boasting an exotic feather[cite: 1]. Provides no armor bonus.
items.notes: Carried by the ailing Brent Filiant, who willingly surrenders it to whoever brings him a curative Red Potion[cite: 1].

items.name: Curative Red Potion
items.specs: Ruby-red alchemical brew restoring 10 Hit Points and curing mild venom[cite: 1].
items.notes: Available at The Blue Bottle[cite: 1], concocted from red marsh herbs and an empty vial[cite: 1], or traded to Brent Filiant for the Wealthy Hat[cite: 1].

items.name: Spiral Giant Seashell
items.specs: Heavy mother-of-pearl conch shell measuring two feet in diameter[cite: 1].
items.notes: Resting inside the abandoned coastal hut on the northwestern peninsula[cite: 1]; satisfies Judge Grey's exploration token[cite: 1].

items.name: Lunar Mosaic Floor Tile
items.specs: Carved stone floor slab inlaid with silver lunar tracery[cite: 1]. Weighs 10 lbs.
items.notes: Pried from the secret southern library of the Temple of the Moon[cite: 1]; serves as the subterranean relic for the contest[cite: 1].

items.name: Cavern Yew Longbow
items.specs: Composite yew longbow (+2 Ranged Attack, 1d8+2 piercing damage)[cite: 1].
items.notes: Lying among the scorched remains near the entrance to Morcarack's cavern[cite: 1]; serves as the weapon token for Judge Grey[cite: 1].

items.name: Scorched Contestant's Crest
items.specs: Heavily warped steel heater shield bearing the crest of Markham's missing team (+3 AC)[cite: 1].
items.notes: Sought by Lord Markham as conclusive proof of the fate of the missing adventurers[cite: 1].

items.name: Malwick's Wand of Fireballs
items.specs: Obsidian rod loaded with 20 charges of 6d6 AoE Fireball. High market value.
items.notes: Smuggled contraband wielded by Mr. Malwick to ensnare contestants in debt.

trackers.name: Rival Scavenger Progress Clock
trackers.notes: Advances by 1 tick whenever the party takes a full rest, trains at the grounds, or falls in battle. At 6 ticks, an opposing team presents all six tokens and claims Harmondale.

trackers.name: Morcarack's Slumber & Cavern Alert
trackers.notes: Advances by 1 tick if high-tier explosive magic is detonated near the caverns or if trespassers linger in Node 26 without stealth[cite: 1]. At 4 ticks, the dragon awakens fully and unleashes breath weapon sweeps across the approaches[cite: 1].
